_note: DRAFT POLL LIBRARY. Nobody has approved these. Every question carries "draft": true and none of them should go on a screen until Carol, Lisa, or the presenter running that session says yes. Questions are drafted against data/agenda.json and nothing else. No statistic, no benchmark, and no club result is used as an answer anywhere in this file, because inventing one would put a fake number in front of the room.

meta.task: ROADMAP T3.5, starter library. Crowd Vote itself is T2.4.

types.choice: Multiple choice. Opinion, no right answer. options is an array of strings, rendered as full width buttons.
types.knowledge: Knowledge check. Carries correctIndex, a zero based index into options, and explain, which is only shown once admin closes the poll. Every correct answer in here is a fact already in the repo, taken from data/agenda.json or the VENUES table in index.html. If a source changes, re-check the answer.
types.ranking: Drag to order. options is the list to be ordered. Results are an averaged rank, so keep the list short. Ranking seven things on a phone is a slog.
types.wordcloud: One word answers, rendered live. options is empty. wordLimit is how many words a single answer may hold.

fields.id: Library id. Stable, so a question can be swapped without losing what it was.
fields.session: Session key from data/agenda.json, so admin can see which session a question belongs to. Empty means it is not tied to one session.
fields.question: What the room reads.
fields.options: Answers or items. Empty for wordcloud.
fields.explain: knowledge only. Shown on close, never before.
fields.draft: Always true in this file. Approval is a person saying yes, not a default.
fields.crewNote: Why the question exists and what still needs a decision. Crew only, never shown to the room.

openQuestions: Wednesday evening is settled. Lisa cancelled Smash Park on Aug 12 and the evening is at the hotel: 6:00 drinks, 6:30 dinner, 7:00 to 9:00 karaoke and games. The denim question below still leans on the attire wording, which is open at T1.1b. Re-check that one thing before publishing it.
The seven Core Fundamentals breakout titles are used verbatim as answer options in three questions. If the breakout list changes, those three change with it.
Nothing is drafted for the Vault drops, the Cares Cup, or the Awards Show. Those want live polls written in the room, not a library.

polls.question: Seven breakouts. Which one does your club need most?
polls.crewNote: Options are the seven breakout titles verbatim from the agenda. Do not reword them, the room is about to see the same words on the schedule. Good opener for the 9:30 Core Fundamentals session, because it tells the breakout leads where the interest is before anyone splits up.

polls.question: How many Core Fundamentals breakouts are on Wednesday?
polls.explain: Seven. They are all on The Setlist under the 9:45 AM card.
polls.crewNote: Deliberately easy. It is a warm-up that teaches people the voting control works, and it points them at The Setlist. Answer comes from data/agenda.json.

polls.question: What time is Wednesday's Opening Cowbell?
polls.explain: 8:45 AM. 7:45 is breakfast, 9:05 is Opening Remarks, 9:30 is Playlist 1.
polls.crewNote: Logistics dressed up as a poll. Best used Tuesday night at the mixer, not Wednesday morning, when knowing it is already too late. REWRITTEN Aug 13 2026 after Carol moved the times. Every fact in the old version had gone stale at once: the cowbell was 8:20, breakfast 7:30 and Opening Remarks 8:45, and the stored correct answer still pointed at 8:20. A knowledge poll with a wrong answer, in front of the room. Re-check this one whenever the Wednesday morning times move.

polls.question: Which day can you get away with denim?
polls.explain: Wednesday. Denim is in for the Dress-Up Day costumes and fine at the hotel that evening. Tuesday and Thursday are no denim.
polls.crewNote: Leans on the attire wording at T1.1b, which is not settled. Confirm with Carol before this one runs, because the printed flier in the welcome packet may say something different.
